title: Core Galois action formula on geometric etale lifts
statement: Under the field and separable-closure hypotheses of the geometric point over Spec K, there exists a monoid homomorphism from Gal(Ks/K) to endomorphisms of the geometric etale fibre functor satisfying the precomposition formula for every extending automorphism of Omega. No openness is asserted.

proof.text: The construction extends field automorphisms and acts by precomposition; finite separable residue fields ensure independence and openness.

mathlib_searches.query: Galois action on geometric etale lifts

lean.statement:
theorem exists_galoisPointAction_core
    (K Ks Ω : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ks] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra K Ks] [IsSepClosure K Ks] [Algebra Ks Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    [IsScalarTower K Ks Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] :
    let S := Spec (.of K)
    let s := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω))
    let p := pointSmallEtale s
    ∃ ρ : Gal(Ks/K) →* End p.fiber,
      ∀ (g : Gal(Ks/K)) (τ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω)
          (_ : (algebraMap Ks Ω).comp g.toRingHom =
            τ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Ks Ω))
          (X : S.Etale) (x : p.fiber.obj X),
        ((ρ g).app X x).left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ.toRingHom) ≫ x.left
